summary: Landmark Bancorp filed an 8-K reporting Q1 2026 financial results and a $0.21/share cash dividend. The filing is a routine earnings announcement and dividend declaration, not a special situation. No M&A, activist, or restructuring activity is disclosed. The dividend of $0.21 per share will be paid on May 28, 2026, to holders of record on May 14, 2026. This is a standard periodic reporting event with no special-situation characteristics.
